goal: Speed up serving witness-stripped block requests to legacy peers and future witnessless sync clients
Reduce CPU and memory overhead by avoiding decoding and re-serializing full blocks from disk
agreement: Strong support with thorough testing and benchmarks (fametrano)
Verified byte-for-byte output equivalence and 7x to 9x speedups across hundreds of blocks (fametrano)
Confirmed serialization on blocks with extreme witness stacks and annexes after rebase (fametrano)
